acceptanceCriteria: A make target runs a pinned, checksum-verified actionlint over .github/workflows
The lane charter's pre-push list names it for changes under .github/
body: Lane ci-tools-1021i recorded actionlint NOT_RUN while editing ci.yml and ci-control-plane.yml. Expected: a pinned, checksum-verified actionlint is available (or a make target fetches one into a tool cache), so .github workflow changes are linted before push. Actual: workflow syntax errors are found only by hosted CI.
title: tooling: actionlint is not installed on the dev host, so workflow edits ship without a local lint
